note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list as published by the trophy trackers that agree on it (PowerPyx, PSNProfiles, Exophase). Every guide below is written in our own words for this guide; each cites the sources its facts come from. Where a specific step could not be verified in a published guide yet, the guide says so honestly.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned. There is no separate task: follow the roadmap, finish the story, reach 100% completion, then clean up the remaining activities and stranger strands. PowerPyx puts the whole run at about 200 hours at difficulty 4/10, in a single playthrough with no online trophies and no DLC required.
steps: Finish the story (Chapters 1-5) and the optional missions as they appear.
Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story and work through the checklist.
Clean up Strangers & Freaks strands and any leftover activity trophies.
The platinum unlocks as soon as the last other trophy pops.

trophies.guide: An automatic story trophy. Play through the opening mission Gone Fishing and it unlocks when the mission ends. It cannot be missed: every story mission is required to finish the game, and there is no mission replay, so just keep playing the story in order.
steps: Play the story until you reach Gone Fishing.
Complete the mission.

After the mission Down to Earth, look for Lucia at Jason's house in the morning and accept her invitation to meditate on the balcony before you leave Chapter 1.
steps: In Chapter 1, after Down to Earth, meditate with Lucia at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude).
Finish every Chapter 1 mission; the trophy pops at the chapter's end.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the game, and the one the whole roadmap is built around. After the final mission, the 100% Completion checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. PowerPyx stresses it is lenient — closer to 60% true completion: you need 70 of the 80 challenges, 15 of the 18 card sets, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned and 100 of 255 animals studied, but every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest is required. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on the checklist is missable.
steps: Finish the story, then open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Work the checklist in any order: robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret quests must all be done.
Reach 70 of 80 challenges and the partial targets for cards, vehicles and animals.
The trophy pops at 100% on the checklist.

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 stunts across Leonida. PowerPyx counts 397 stunts in total — stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all count, and you can mix them freely. The 100% checklist asks for 300, so keep going past this trophy if you are chasing A Long Road. Track your count in Progress > Stats and mop up the easy stunt jumps first.
steps: Do stunt jumps, bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps as you travel.
Check Progress > Stats for your stunt count.
The trophy pops at 250; the 100% checklist needs 300.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once. KeenGamer confirms there are nine types; the exact list of the nine has not yet been confirmed in a published guide, but the activities the game surfaces — racing, fishing, shooting ranges, drone races, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting and stunt driving — are the natural candidates. Just sample one of each as you meet them during the story and this pops early.
steps: As each new activity appears, try it once.
Work through racing, fishing, shooting range, drone race, arcade, bowling and the rest.
The trophy pops when the ninth type is tried.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 ranges. This is one of the skill-based trophies: every challenge must be gold, not just completed, and all 42 are also required for the 100% checklist. Practise a range until you know its targets, then chase gold one challenge at a time — there is no time limit on retrying.
steps: Visit shooting ranges as you find them (12 in total).
Complete each challenge, then replay it until you earn gold.
All 42 gold medals are needed; the trophy pops on the last one.

Win at least one race at every location.

steps: Find race events around Leonida.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.guide: THE ONLY POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY. Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations, per the published lists. PowerPyx flags it because the first meditation, at Jason's house, can only be done in Chapter 1: after the mission Down to Earth, look for Lucia at Jason's house in the morning; when she mentions meditating, follow her to the balcony and accept. Do the Chapter 1 meditation before you finish Chapter 1, then meditate at every spot you find for the rest of the game.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's 80 challenges. PowerPyx counts 80 challenges in eight groups of ten, and the 100% checklist needs 70, so this trophy is a milestone on the way to A Long Road. Challenges cover the game's activities — stunts, races, robberies and more — so most of them complete themselves while you chase the other trophies; pick the easiest remaining ones to reach 50, and the hardest ones can be skipped since only 70 of 80 are needed for 100%.
steps: Play normally; challenges complete as you do activities.
Check Progress > Stats for your challenge count.
Top up with the easiest remaining challenges to reach 50 (70 for 100%).

trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it. Doing it with your partner present is the requirement, so do not run off alone.
steps: Make sure your partner is with you.
Raise your wanted level to 4 stars.
Escape and stay hidden until the wanted level clears.

trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without your wanted level dropping in between. The trick is the 'back-to-back' chain: keep the wanted level alive from the first robbery to the third, so plan a route past three shops, hit them quickly one after another, and do not escape the police until the third is done.
steps: Bring your partner and pick a route past three shops.
Rob the first shop, then move straight to the next two.
Keep the wanted level up through all three robberies.

Trigger Combat Focus.
Take down 5 enemies before Combat Focus ends.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. This trophy is tied to a story choice — one of the decisions the game asks you to make during the story. It pops when that choice is made, whichever way you choose, so it cannot be missed by picking the 'wrong' option. Which choice it is has not yet been confirmed in a published guide, so just play the story and make your choices; the trophy should come to you.
steps: Play the story and make the choices it offers.
The trophy pops when the linked choice is made.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The description suggests succeeding at something on the second attempt — most likely retrying a failed activity or mission objective and passing it the second time. It is not flagged as missable by PowerPyx, which lists only Positive Mental Attitude, so a failed first attempt is nothing to fear. The exact trigger has not yet been confirmed in a published guide.
steps: If you fail an activity or objective, retry it and succeed on the second attempt.
If it has not popped by the end of the story, check the PowerPyx guide for the confirmed trigger.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The description points to one of the game's strange, hidden events — the kind of odd encounter players stumble into while exploring Leonida. The exact event has not yet been confirmed in a published guide, so explore off the beaten path, investigate anything unusual you find, and check the PowerPyx guide once the community has pinned the trigger down.
steps: Explore Leonida and investigate unusual sights and events.
If it has not popped by the end of the story, check the PowerPyx guide for the confirmed trigger.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by: while driving past someone, hit them with a melee attack from the vehicle — the 'bowling' is the victim going flying. Find a pedestrian on a quiet road, drive past slowly, and swing a melee weapon from the car. The exact number of victims needed has not yet been confirmed in a published guide, so start with one and keep going if it does not pop.
steps: Get a melee weapon and a car.
Drive past a pedestrian and hit them with a melee attack from the vehicle.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — bank vaults, armored trucks, gang operations — and your contacts turn them into clean cash. Keep robbing and laundering as you work the 100% checklist, and the total adds up on its own. Check Progress > Stats for your laundered total.
steps: Rob bank vaults, armored trucks and gang operations to collect Marked Bills.
Launder the bills through your contacts.
Reach $250,000 laundered in total.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Every dollar you spend in any shop counts — clothes, weapons, food, car mods — so this pops naturally as you gear up through the game. If you are close at the end, buy an expensive vehicle upgrade or a wardrobe refresh to push past the line. The total is cumulative across all shops.
steps: Spend money in shops as you play.
Check Progress > Stats for your spending total.
Top up with a big purchase if you are short.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties in Leonida. Garages are bought through the in-game property market; each one also gives you somewhere to store the vehicles you register for On the Spot. Save up through the story — robberies and laundered Marked Bills are the income — and buy every garage on the market. The exact number of garages has not yet been confirmed in a published guide.
steps: Earn money through the story and robberies.
Buy every garage property on the market.
The trophy pops when the last garage is bought.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles you like around Leonida, take them to a garage, and register them through the app. Any 10 vehicles count, so register the ones you already drive rather than hunting rare ones. This pairs naturally with Whip It Good and Little Boxes.
steps: Find a vehicle and take it to a garage.
Register it to the Scooter Bros app.
Repeat for 10 different vehicles.

roadmap.title: Step 1 — The story (60–80 hours)
roadmap.summary: Play Chapters 1–5, do the optional missions as they appear, and protect the one possibly-missable trophy. Scan vehicles and locations with WAiNK as you go.
warnings: Do the Chapter 1 meditation with Lucia at Jason's house (Positive Mental Attitude) before Chapter 1 ends.
Never use cheats — they disable trophies and saving.
Save manually at the start and end of every chapter; there is no mission replay.

roadmap.title: Step 2 — 100% Completion (about 100 hours)
roadmap.summary: After the final mission, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work the checklist: every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest, plus 70 of 80 challenges.
warnings: The checklist is lenient: 15 of 18 card sets, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals studied.
All 42 Shooting Range gold medals and all drone races are required.

roadmap.title: Step 3 — Strangers & cleanup (about 10 hours)
roadmap.summary: Finish the 8 stranger strands, the named strangers' final missions, and whatever activity trophies are left. Every trophy quest giver returns after the story.
warnings: Andy is Lucia-only; Tyrone and Bret are Jason-only — switch characters for their strands.
The platinum pops as soon as the last trophy does.
